$comment: Example USERS_JSON_PATH file — accounts plus access policy. Copy to data/users.json and replace every hashed_password (make hash p=<password>; the one below is the hash of 'secret'). Validate before deploying: make check-users f=<file>. Full guide: README 'Access policy'.

policies.$comment: Global rule: applies to every user, admin included. Every write on a prod-* cluster is refused.
policies.description: prod clusters are maintained by the SRE pipeline, not through this service

policies.$comment: Both match keys must hit (AND): only control-plane nodes, on any cluster.
policies.description: control-plane nodes are never cordoned, drained or tainted by hand
platform namespaces are labelled and annotated by their own controllers

users.$comment: No rules of its own: only the global rules above apply.

An allow list: for the actions it names, the request must match one allow rule. node.taint is denied outright. namespace.label and namespace.annotate are in no operator rule, so only the global rules restrict them.

policies.description: operator works on dev and staging clusters only

users.$comment: A read-only user: '*' covers every policed action, so every write is refused; reads are never policed.
